definitions.explanation: The obligation or practice of keeping information private, especially in professional or legal settings.

examples.japanese: {守秘|しゅひ}{義務|ぎむ}がある。
examples.english: There is an obligation of confidentiality.

examples.japanese: {個人|こじん}{情報|じょうほう}の{守秘|しゅひ}は{重要|じゅうよう}だ。
examples.english: Confidentiality of personal information is important.

examples.japanese: {医師|いし}には{患者|かんじゃ}の{情報|じょうほう}に{関|かん}する{守秘|しゅひ}{義務|ぎむ}が{課|か}されている。
examples.english: Doctors are bound by a duty of confidentiality regarding patient information.

notes:
Refers to keeping information secret or confidential, especially in professional or legal contexts. A compound of {守|しゅ} (protect) and {秘|ひ} (secret). Most commonly encountered in the compound {守秘|しゅひ}{義務|ぎむ} (duty of confidentiality).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {守秘|しゅひ}{義務|ぎむ}: duty of confidentiality; NDA obligation
- {守秘|しゅひ}{契約|けいやく}: confidentiality agreement; NDA
- {守秘|しゅひ}を{徹底|てってい}する: to ensure strict confidentiality
- {守秘|しゅひ}{事項|じこう}: confidential matters

RELATED WORDS:
- {機密|きみつ}: classified information; secrecy
- {秘密|ひみつ}: secret — more general and everyday
- {極秘|ごくひ}: top secret
